name: Databasus
description: Scheduled backups of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and MongoDB databases to local storage, S3, Google Drive, SFTP and others, with retention, encryption, restore and notifications to Slack, Discord, Telegram or e-mail. It reaches each database over the network, so one on this host must be reachable from its container.

access.note: Databasus starts with no account: the first account signed up administers the instance. Open the address yourself right after deploying and create it before anyone else can.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the interface is opened at; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The web interface and its API

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Its own database, settings and the backups kept on local storage

update.notes: Databasus migrates its own database on start; back up the data volume, which also holds local backups, before updating.
